notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.651
notes.notes:
Hello there!

Now you can play the demo without big headaches.

1. Added a window informing you how to play and interact with the world.
2. Fixed the Vibus quest - now you can craft some weapons.
3. Jawans cup disapears after giving it back to him.
4. The pickup does not get stuck when there are 2 items close.
5. You can talk to Amulius after finishing the quest.
6. Fixed rare bug when the bandits died under Jawan - and you could not talk to him
7. Except an suprise Fernos(Bear) you can find a way to win a fight with all animals on the map.
8. Added more ways to get a bow.

Yours 
Farathan Team
